facts.fact: 门外是 Maggie's Café 的老板娘 Maggie（塔姆辛只是推定她叫 Maggie），她专程把围巾送到门口
facts.anchor: Maggie—or who I assumed was called Maggie—from Maggie’s Café was on my doorstep.

facts.fact: Maggie 递上一条格子呢围巾（tartan scarf），说 Viv 讲这是塔姆辛昨晚落在酒馆的
facts.anchor: She held out a tartan scarf.

facts.fact: 塔姆辛认出围巾：上次见它是蒙在邻居眼睛上、她正在瞄准投环（即 ch26 那场"幽灵聚会"），因此断定邻居不是鬼——鬼不会大白天去酒馆
facts.anchor: The last time I’d seen it, it had been tied over my neighbour’s eyes as she aimed a hoop.

facts.fact: 她本想把围巾从 1a 的信箱塞进去，临时改挂到门把手上，理由是这是她唯一的实物证据
facts.anchor: This was my only concrete proof. Proof of what, I didn’t know yet, but I didn’t want to let it go so easily.

facts.fact: Maggie 说一直以为 1a 空着、和塔姆辛那栋一样——村民口径里邻居的房子无人居住
facts.anchor: “I thought it was empty, like yours,” said Maggie, watching me carefully.

facts.fact: 被问"有没有好好吃饭"后她的自我辩护：我是能干活的人，会劈柴、会烧锅炉、能独自搬家
facts.anchor: I am a capable woman. I can chop wood and work a boiler and move house all by myself.

facts.fact: Rowan 要的不是她的车而是副驾：他开送树苗的小货车走山路，需要人陪着（learner 的 L 牌贴挡风玻璃）
facts.anchor: “I don’t need your car. I just need someone who can sit with me while I drive the van.”

facts.fact: 她出门前掏出口袋里那根地下室捡到的针，挂到钥匙环上当钥匙扣——针一直没有丢掉
facts.anchor: I took out the needle I’d found in the basement.
